SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Climatic regions in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.
   D. Say Climatic regions in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

2. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

3. Which statement about Vegetation in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Vegetation in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Vegetation in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Eastern Africa.
   D. Explain Vegetation in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Beef Farming is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Beef Farming as rumours only.
   B. Explain Beef Farming with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Beef Farming never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Beef Farming.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

6. Which statement about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.
   C. Treat Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Culture and Social Organisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Culture and Social Organisation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Culture and Social Organisation as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Culture and Social Organisation.
   D. Explain Culture and Social Organisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Language groups in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Language groups in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Language groups in Eastern Africa.
   D. Say Language groups in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa.
   B. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historic Built Environments as rumours only.
   B. Say Historic Built Environments never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments.
   D. Explain Historic Built Environments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

12. Which statement about Fishing in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Fishing in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Fishing in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Fishing in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Eastern Africa.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Human rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Government Revenue and Expenditure and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
